name: The Wheatbaker Hotel
description: Boutique luxury hotel offering world-class suites, a rooftop pool, and an award-winning restaurant in the heart of Ikoyi. Known for exceptional service and understated elegance.

name: Eko Hotel & Suites
description: Lagos's most iconic hotel. Five-star amenities, multiple restaurants, convention centre, and a legendary swimming pool complex on the VI waterfront.

name: Nok by Alara
description: Contemporary African fine dining in a stunning design space. The menu fuses traditional Nigerian flavours with modern technique. Book in advance — always full.

name: Chef Tunde Private Kitchen
description: Award-winning private chef available for dinner parties, corporate events, and weekly meal prep. Specialises in elevated Nigerian cuisine and continental menus. Fully insured, references available.

name: Sky Bar Lagos
description: Rooftop lounge with panoramic views of Victoria Island and the Atlantic Ocean. Live DJ every Friday and Saturday. Dress code enforced. Best sunset spot in Lagos.

name: Vanguard Protection Services
description: Licensed personal security detail for high-net-worth individuals, executives, and visiting dignitaries. Close protection officers, armoured vehicle escorts, and event security. Discreet and professional.

name: Radisson Blu Hotel
description: Contemporary business hotel with stunning harbour views, a rooftop bar, spa facilities, and modern conference rooms. Close to the financial district.

name: Lagos Continental Hotel
description: Premium 5-star hotel with 358 rooms, stunning ocean views, multiple dining options, and a full-service spa. A landmark on Victoria Island.

name: Circa Lagos
description: Chic boutique hotel with 20 individually designed rooms, a lush courtyard garden, and a popular bar. The go-to spot for creatives visiting Lagos.

name: Eden Heights Apartments
description: Fully serviced 2 and 3 bedroom apartments with 24/7 power supply, high-speed wifi, gym, swimming pool and a concierge team. Short and long stay available.

name: Magnolia Suites
description: Elegant serviced apartments near Murtala Muhammed Airport. Ideal for business travellers. Includes daily cleaning, breakfast, and airport transfers.

name: Harbour Point Residences
description: Luxury waterfront serviced apartments with panoramic ocean views. 1-4 bedroom options available with premium finishes and hotel-grade amenities.

name: Nomad Lagos
description: Modern co-living and short-stay apartments designed for the digital nomad. Fast fibre internet, co-working space, and a vibrant community of young professionals.

name: Craft Grill
description: Upscale grill restaurant known for its dry-aged Nigerian beef, wood-fired dishes, and excellent craft cocktail bar. The suya-style ribeye is unmatched in Lagos.

name: Yellow Chilli
description: Celebrity chef's signature restaurant serving elevated Nigerian classics. The signature egusi soup and jollof rice have drawn visitors from around the world.

name: Escape Lounge & Bar
description: Popular upscale lounge with an Afrobeats-heavy playlist, bottle service, and an extensive cocktail menu. The shisha terrace is the most booked spot on weekends.

name: Hard Rock Cafe Lagos
description: The legendary global brand comes to Lagos. Rock memorabilia, burgers, cocktails, and live music performances. A reliable night out for locals and tourists alike.

name: Lagos Clean Ride
description: Premium airport pickup and drop-off service. Clean, air-conditioned vehicles. Flight tracking included so they're always on time. Book 2 hours before arrival.

name: FirstClass Transfers NG
description: Executive airport transfers in Mercedes and Toyota Venza fleets. Professional chauffeurs, meet-and-greet at arrivals, and real-time WhatsApp updates throughout your journey.

name: Airport Mover Lagos
description: Affordable and reliable airport transfers from Murtala Muhammed Airport to any part of Lagos. Shared and private options. 24/7 operations, no hidden charges.

name: Lagos Plumbing Pros
description: Licensed plumbers available 24/7 for emergency and scheduled work. Specialising in residential and commercial plumbing, pipe repairs, and bathroom installation.

name: CoolBreeze AC Services
description: Air conditioning installation, service, and repair. All major brands covered. Home and office visits. Quick response times and transparent pricing with no surprise charges.

name: GlowUp Studio
description: Full-service beauty studio — hair, makeup, nails, and skincare. Walk-ins welcome. Known for natural hair care and flawless bridal makeup. Booked weeks in advance for events.

name: Lagos Dispatch Riders
description: Same-day package and document delivery across all of Lagos. Tracking via WhatsApp. Trusted by over 500 businesses for reliable, fast dispatch services.

name: Sheraton Lagos Hotel
description: Full-service Marriott hotel adjacent to Lagos airport with 4 restaurants, rooftop pool, fitness centre, and extensive conference facilities. The top choice for business travellers flying in.

name: Madam Kofo Private Chef
description: Experienced private chef specialising in authentic Yoruba cuisine and healthy meal prep. Available for weekly cooking sessions, dinner parties, and special occasions. Groceries sourced fresh daily.

name: The Lagos Table
description: Luxury private dining experiences brought to your home. Curated multi-course menus, trained servers, and full setup included. Popular for proposals, anniversaries, and corporate client dinners.

name: Eagle Eye Security
description: Trained personal security operatives for individuals and families. Home protection, travel escorts, and event security. All officers are ex-military with active licenses.

name: Volt Electrical NG
description: Certified electricians for home and office. Rewiring, inverter installation, generator maintenance, and solar panel setup. COREN-registered professionals.
